name: NewAIForYou

sources.title: Homepage — AI tools directory updated daily
Submit your AI Tool — minimal form (Tool Name, Tool Website URL) plus FAQ describing free badge-code route
Pricing — Premium Plan $49.9 (marked down from a struck 'Free' label), dofollow backlink, permanent listing

conditions: Free submission requires copying a code/badge snippet from the submission page and adding it to your website's homepage (per the submit FAQ)
Only AI-related tools are accepted — 'Currently, we only accept AI-related tools'
Review takes 'typically 1-2 business days' before publication
requirements: Tool must be AI-related with a valid website URL
One tool per submission — 'you can submit one ai at a time'
Free route requires embedding their code on your homepage (badge/link exchange)
Pricing page lists a single Premium plan at $49.9 promising dofollow backlink, multilingual introduction, permanent listing
preparation: Tool name and website URL — that is all the public form asks for
Ability to edit your homepage HTML to paste their badge/code for the free route
Decide free badge route vs $49.9 Premium (traffic, dofollow link, multilingual writeup)
workflow: For free submission: copy the provided code and place it on your site's homepage first
Fill Tool Name and Tool Website URL, click Submit
Wait for review — stated 1–2 business days
To edit a listing later, contact the support team — there is no self-serve editing
watchFor: Pricing page shows 'Free $49.9' with a struck-through label and 'Save $49.9 today!' — perpetual-sale framing; the paid plan is $49.9, not free
Free path is a badge/link exchange — the badge must live on your homepage, and removal may cost the listing
No self-serve editing: changes go through support
No submission statistics are provided ('we do not provide statistics for submitted tools')
Site is part of a footer-linked family of AI directories (Woy AI, Toolsapp, Tap4 AI, DokeyAI, AIStage, etc.)
countsAsLive: Tool appears on a public detail page under newaiforyou.com/ai/<slug> and in the 'Just Launched' or category listings
unknowns: Whether account login is required to submit (a Log In button exists but the public form only asks name + URL)
Whether the badge code is verified automatically or manually
Rejection criteria and whether submitters are notified
